description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
description.zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

description.en: Playwright browser automation for DeepSeek Harness｜面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Playwright 浏览器自动化插件
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 Playwright 自动操作浏览器，轻松完成网页抓取、表单填写和自动化测试。

description.en: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
description.zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

description.en: 千星沙箱模拟器：Lua 驱动的 2D 奇域外置沙箱 ，支持 DeepSeek Harness、Web 和 MCP
Poppin'Party Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness (local models, zero external deps)
Interactive terminal UI for deepseek-harness, installed as a dsh profile bundle
Session-scoped Playwright browser runtime for DeepSeek Harness and QA Surface
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle: wires Kimi Computer Use's stdio MCP server through the generic dsh-mcp-client bridge, plus a bundled skill for driving it.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes the DSH Web UI for LAN access
description.zh: 将 DSH 的 Web 界面暴露到局域网，方便其他设备远程访问和使用。

description.en: Authorized DSH Remote gateway and XYFlow visual studio for DAG workflows
Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
Persistent owner-scoped business goals over the native DSH goal domain.
Independent, bounded task acceptance verification with durable contracts and receipts.
Capture independently accepted tool workflows and replay versioned skills through the current native Goal and tool authority.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Codex-style progress, tool activity, and final answers.
OpenCode Go & Google Antigravity (Gemini) 智能用量双擎监控面板：支持模型/供应商自适应切源、OAuth 动态额度刷新与对话底栏快捷进度环
OpenAI Codex OAuth provider and native settings UI for DeepSeek Harness

DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in two fixed report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的两份固定报告里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines on the same local network with a one-time code, letting one agent run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.
description.zh: 用一次性配对码把同一局域网内的两台 DeepSeek Harness 机器连起来，让一边的 agent 能在另一边执行任务并交换文件，而各自的文件都留在本机。

description.en: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.
description.zh: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.

description.en: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
description.zh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

description.en: Compresses older DSH context into a structured handoff, retains recent messages, and keeps session history searchable.
description.zh: 将较早的 DSH 上下文压缩为结构化交接，保留最近消息，并让会话历史保持可搜索。

description.en: Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.
description.zh: 通过 Better Sidebar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享浏览器面板，支持本地 Chromium、人和 AI 的鼠标键盘操作、页面快照、截图及按聊天持久保存的浏览器资料。

description.en: Replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai through a safe-zone download with a one-click enable toggle, and adds provider quota and balance lookups plus a provider management page.
description.zh: 把内置的 llm-pi-ai 与 llm-deepseek 适配器、模型选择器、模型服务设置页替换为自维护版本；经安全区下载跟踪上游 @earendil-works/pi-ai 并提供一键启用开关；另加供应商额度与余额查询、供应商管理页。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 结构化提示词优化：将输入栏草稿改写为角色/任务/上下文/约束/格式，支持普通/精简/扩写，弹窗含评分与继续优化，引擎可选本地、hybrid、DSH 或云端 API。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: obsidian_status/list/search/read/write/append, plus obsidian:// open via the Windows app. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/ so Obsidian can watch files; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.
description.zh: 把 WSL 里的 dsh agent 接到 Windows NTFS 上的 Obsidian vault：提供 obsidian_status/list/search/read/write/append，并用 obsidian:// 打开 Windows 版 Obsidian。vault 请放在 /mnt/<盘符>/ 下以便监视文件变更；放在 Linux 盘经 \\wsl$ 打开不可靠。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。
在对话界面实时查看每次会话的 token 用量、耗时和工具调用统计，方便你掌握资源消耗和运行状态。

description.en: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的终端工作台，提供流式对话、工具执行、会话管理、Provider 管理与图片输入。

description.en: A keyboard-first command palette for standard DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘优先的命令面板，快速执行操作，提升操作效率。

description.en: Tiered compaction hub: replaces the single 80% compaction cliff with a configurable ladder (default 30/50/70/90) whose tiers escalate from gentle to maximum consolidation laws, folds a deterministic keyword index into every checkpoint so facts accumulate across cycles, and summarizes through a model chain — primary plus up to 3 fallbacks, each with its own reasoning effort. Adds a Compaction module sub-tab and a Settings card; toggling off always restores stock compaction.
description.zh: 分级压缩中枢：把单一的 80% 压缩阈值换成可配置的阶梯（默认 30/50/70/90），逐级加强压缩力度；每次检查点都折叠入确定性关键词索引，让事实跨周期累积；摘要走模型链——主模型加最多 3 个回退，各自独立推理档位。附带 Compaction 模块子标签页与设置卡片；关闭插件始终恢复原版压缩。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.
description.zh: 常驻界面的鲸鱼娘：随智能体状态切换动画，可摸头互动、喂小鱼干养亲密度，从幼鲸一路养成。

description.en: Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.
description.zh: DSH 会话修改审查：追踪 write/edit 工具调用，集成 diff2html 实现 VS Code 风格 side-by-side diff，自动跟随主题，支持子代理聚合与一键撤回。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.
description.zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：图片背景，可调透明度、压暗遮罩与模糊。
